codex-skills.description: Personal or team Codex skills expected under ~/.codex/skills.
codex-skills.fallback: Use OwnCanvas repo docs: CONTEXT.md for DDD terms, .agents/product-marketing-context.md for marketing, and DESIGN.md for UI.

gstack.description: gstack review and planning skills expected under ~/.gstack/repos/gstack/.agents/skills.
gstack.fallback: Use the AGENTS.md routing rules directly and record assumptions in plans/context.

superpowers.fallback: Use plain repo plans in plans/ and execute them step by step with verification in context/.

skills.name: DDD-zoom-out
skills.when: Use before changing domain shape, object names, context boundaries, or product mental models.
skills.fallback: Read CONTEXT.md and write down the domain boundary decision in the active plan.

skills.name: DDD-grill-with-docs
skills.when: Use when product/domain wording needs pressure-testing against existing docs.
skills.fallback: Compare proposed language against CONTEXT.md, README.md, and .agents/product-marketing-context.md.

skills.name: DDD-improve-architecture
skills.when: Use before refactoring feature boundaries, adapters, models, or domain modules.
skills.fallback: Keep domain language in app/features/*/model and isolate framework/provider glue in adapters.

skills.name: DDD-tdd
skills.when: Use for behavior changes where domain rules should be specified before implementation.
skills.fallback: Write the expected domain behavior in the plan, implement the smallest slice, then verify it locally.

skills.name: marketing-ideas
skills.when: Use when generating acquisition, positioning, launch, or growth ideas.
skills.fallback: Use .agents/product-marketing-context.md and keep ideas tied to the local-first/BYO-provider wedge.

skills.name: product-marketing-context
skills.when: Use when changing positioning, personas, objections, value proposition, or copy direction.

skills.name: community-marketing
skills.when: Use when planning community-led distribution, audience research, or founder-led channels.
skills.fallback: Anchor community ideas to creative operators, solo founders, agencies, and open-source users.

skills.name: marketing-psychology
skills.when: Use when evaluating motivation, objections, switching friction, and persuasion.
skills.fallback: Use the objections and switching dynamics in .agents/product-marketing-context.md.

skills.name: office-hours
skills.when: Use for founder-style critique of product direction, wedge, urgency, or why-now.
skills.fallback: State the product thesis, strongest objection, and next test in the plan.

skills.name: plan-ceo-review
skills.when: Use before starting a plan that affects product scope, prioritization, or business direction.
skills.fallback: Review the plan for scope, user value, sequencing, and smallest shippable slice.

skills.name: plan-eng-review
skills.when: Use before implementation plans that change architecture, data flow, or shared code.
skills.fallback: Review the plan for blast radius, tests, rollback, and integration risk.

skills.name: design-review
skills.when: Use after UI work or before finalizing visual interaction decisions.
skills.fallback: Check the UI against DESIGN.md, responsive constraints, contrast, and text fit.

skills.name: superpowers:writing-plans
skills.when: Use when turning a request into an implementation plan or execution checklist.
skills.fallback: Write a plan in plans/ with background, goal, scope, files, tests, rollback, and risks.

skills.name: superpowers:writing-skills
skills.when: Use when creating, editing, or evaluating reusable skill/process documentation.
skills.fallback: Keep project-specific process in AGENTS.md or .agents/skills/README.md instead of inventing global skill bodies.

skills.name: superpowers:executing-plans
skills.when: Use when executing a written plan through implementation, verification, and completion.
skills.fallback: Execute the plan top to bottom, update status as work completes, and record verification in context/.
